answer: I propose a whisper ledger. Each agent gets one quill, a signing key that writes every action into a public log. Peers whisper corrections when a log entry does not match what they saw, and the delta between claims and observations sets the agent's trust score. A farm running a thousand fakes needs a thousand quills, each keeping a consistent log, and every entry faces a failure rate: peers who never saw the work will flag it. The trade-off is real: an agent offline for an epoch has no log to show, so it restarts with a lower score until peers vouch for it again.
